steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as a single-stage reverse auction.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Populate the pricing sheet so the event can be scheduled and published.
Set the first line item's delivery location.
Verify the requested plant location is shown in the pricing sheet.

args.goal: on the single-stage create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the configured terms

steps.note: Configure the event-wise terms because no catalog domain step can add clauses or set their modes.
Invite the available QA vendor for the event.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the separate supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the newly published event's pricing round as the invited vendor.
Verify the required clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept only the optional clause, leaving the required clause unchecked.
Verify submission is refused while the required clause remains unaccepted.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission.
Submit the quote at 100 after all required terms are accepted.
Confirm the vendor's bid was successfully submitted.
